headline: Vikas Sethi recommends VST Tillers Tractors and Stove Kraft on Zee Business
hook: Expert picks two stocks for potential gains
summary: Market analyst Vikas Sethi has recommended VST Tillers Tractors Limited and Stove Kraft Ltd for investor portfolios on Zee Business. The recommendations focus on short-term profit opportunities based on technical and fundamental analysis discussed during the show. Retail investors tracking expert picks on agricultural equipment and kitchen appliance stocks may evaluate these recommendations against their own risk appetite.
why_it_matters: Expert stock picks may see heightened retail trading volume today.

headline: Escorts Kubota shares fall 6% on declining September tractor sales while VST Tillers rallies 5%
hook: Diverging fortunes in rural farm equipment
summary: Escorts Kubota shares dropped 6% after September tractor sales fell 16.7% year-on-year, driven by a high base, festive shift, patchy monsoon, and lower Kharif sowing. In contrast, VST Tillers shares rallied 5% following a 33% jump in total September sales. Brokerages anticipate that upcoming festive buying, rural demand, and better liquidity will support auto sector volumes ahead. Indian retail investors tracking rural consumption and auto stocks should note the uneven recovery across farm equipment manufacturers.
why_it_matters: Rural demand trends signal uneven recovery for auto investors
winners_losers: VST Tillers gain / Escorts Kubota hurt

headline: VST Tillers releases September 2026 business performance update
hook: September sales data for VST Tillers
summary: V.S.T Tillers Tractors Limited has submitted its monthly business performance report for September 2026 to the NSE. The filing provides operational data regarding the company's tractor and tiller sales for the month. Retail investors can review these figures to assess the company's current demand trends and production momentum.
why_it_matters: Monthly sales data helps track demand trends for farm equipment.
